---
title: "Introduction to Machine Learning Systems"
subtitle: "Semester plan · Volume I"
---

## Overview {#overview}

Students study how data pipelines, training, optimization, and deployment work on
a single machine, and they build a small deep learning framework of their own. The
course assumes Python, linear algebra, basic calculus, and introductory
probability.

## Syllabus and schedule {#syllabus}

The [semester syllabus](https://mlsysbook.ai/instructors/foundations-syllabus.html)
lists one Volume I chapter for each of the 16 weeks. Each offering sets its own
dates and course policies.

## Materials {#materials}

| Resource | Use |
|:---|:---|
| [Volume I](https://mlsysbook.ai/vol1/) | The weekly readings. |
| [Lecture slides](https://mlsysbook.ai/slides/vol1.html) | One deck per chapter, with speaker notes and in-class exercises. |
| [Interactive labs](https://mlsysbook.ai/labs/) | Browser-based experiments that pair with the readings. |
| [TinyTorch](https://mlsysbook.ai/tinytorch/) | The framework students build from scratch, one module at a time. |

## For instructors {#for-instructors}

The course can also serve as the first half of a two-semester sequence that
continues with the [scaling course](../scaling/index.qmd).

## Offerings {#offerings}

The [course directory](../index.qmd) lists courses at other institutions that use
MLSysBook.
